research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Lumafield is advancing industrial computed tomography (CT) solutions, focusing on non-destructive testing and inspection. Their research includes developing an X-ray device with a folded field-of-view, enhancing imaging capabilities. They are also working on cloud-connected CT systems, enabling remote data processing and analysis. Additionally, Lumafield is exploring artificial intelligence for anomaly detection in CT scans, improving defect identification. Their efforts in inference of bright flat-field correction and automatic CT scan parameter setup further enhance imaging precision and efficiency.

press_references.value: Lumafield Introduces Auto-Dimensioning, a GD&T Suite for Accurate, NIST-Traceable 3D Measurement

product_launches.description: Lumafield announced Auto-Dimensioning, a GD&T suite delivering NIST-traceable 3D measurements within its CT platform; the capability is in private beta and slated for general availability in Q1 2026.

press_references.value: See Inside Your Designs - Learn How CT Scanning Finds Hidden Flaws

product_launches.description: Lumafield has introduced three CT scanning solutions—Neptune (lab scanner), Triton (factory-floor CT), and Voyager (cloud-based AI analysis software)—to enhance precision inspection and quality control in engineering and manufacturing.

overview_description.description: Lumafield develops industrial computed tomography (CT) solutions for non-destructive testing and inspection for engineers. Its Neptune X-ray CT scanner provides detailed imaging for engineers to analyze internal structures and detect defects in various materials. The Voyager software platform enables cloud-based AI-powered analysis, offering automated inspections and collaboration tools. Triton, its high-speed CT system, is designed for rapid scanning in high-volume manufacturing environments. Lumafield’s solutions serve industries such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, and medical devices, helping improve product quality and reliability.
